purpose: Aggregate, non-sensitive summary of the controlled multi-hazard source acquisition and QA run. Raw source files are not committed to Git; this record is not a scientific validation certificate.

acquisition.retention_note: Private short-lived workflow artifact. Re-run the existing acquisition workflow to reproduce after expiry; do not treat the artifact as a permanent data store.

limitations: Source timezone is not established; timestamps remain timezone-naive.
Stations have irregular intervals and substantial long gaps.
Ernakulam district coverage is not equivalent to Kochi Corporation coverage.
Rainfall observations are not verified flood/no-flood outcome labels.
Vertical gauge datum/reference and source timezone remain unresolved.
Provider-reported river/basin labels and station identities require review.
River stage is not flood depth; no threshold comparison or flood prediction is enabled.
No records are source-labelled Ernakulam in this download.
Gauge reference, timezone, sampling gaps and some river/basin labels remain unresolved.
District/event mentions are not station-hour labels or ward-level inundation evidence.
The dataset landing page did not clearly establish the applicable licence for redistribution.
Missing dates and impact fields require source-specific treatment.
District-scale summaries cannot be assigned to individual Kochi wards or hours.
Definitions, units, reference periods and missingness require review.
Only records whose Privacy field permits use may be used in shareable derived products.
A few Periyar-area gauge candidates exist in Kerala, but no station crosswalk to local telemetry has been verified.
Event records alone lack a defensible non-event sample and must not be used directly as a calibrated flood probability model.
Event-scale precipitation features may include post-event information and require leakage checks.

datasets.acquisition_status: downloaded_raw_candidate; ZIP integrity and raster metadata inspected; not approved for map/model use
limitations: Valid pixel values have no documented unit or meaning in the inspected raster metadata.
Dataset-specific reuse terms remain unresolved.
Spatial overlap does not establish valid flood depth, probability interpretation, ward exposure or hospital exposure.

datasets.acquisition_status: downloaded_raw_candidate; structure and preliminary spatial QA completed; not approved for exposure analysis
limitations: The Esri layer is a candidate source; data provenance, currency, positional accuracy and licence require review.
Ernakulam district is larger than Kochi Corporation; the inside/outside counts use an unverified boundary candidate.
No facility vulnerability or flood exposure claim is approved.

datasets.acquisition_status: downloaded_raw_candidate; KML structure checked; current legal alignment unverified
limitations: A source catalogue's reported ward count and structurally valid KML do not prove current legal ward delimitation.
Official ward-map file attempt returned HTTP 404 in this run; source recovery and ward-by-ward comparison remain required.
No ward-level hazard/exposure joins should use this candidate until official names, IDs, count, CRS and topology are reconciled.

datasets.acquisition_status: Existing project records retained; not newly acquired by this workflow
datasets.status: Dated KSPCB reports, annual AQI summaries, Edayar estate documents and historical consent records exist in project records.
limitations: Live AQI feed was previously blocked; dated reports do not prove current conditions.
Verified facility coordinates, current consent validity and measured factory-specific air emissions remain unavailable.
AQI alone cannot attribute a pollution episode to an individual factory.
